items.title: Dollar Tree Just Crushed Earnings Expectations. 3 Reasons DLTR Stock Could Keep Climbing in 2027
items.summary: Dollar Tree stripped itself down to one banner and Wall Street is still scrambling to price it. The math behind the next leg higher hinges on traffic, bigger baskets, and one tariff-driven distortion that makes next year's earnings look flat.

items.title: 3 big reasons why Black Friday will probably exceed retailer expectations
items.summary:
The Super Bowl for shopping and everything discounts and deals is upon us once again: Black Friday. 

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi examines why this year's Black Friday could be a huge event for retailers as US consumers prepare to spend big for the holidays.

items.title: Inflation-Wary Shoppers Prepare for Black Friday
items.summary: Retailers had plenty of reasons to be worried about this year's holiday season, but the latest round of earnings, from Dick's Sporting Goods Inc. to Kohl's Corp. and Dollar Tree Inc., show that shoppers are still spending briskly, despite their concerns about rising costs. Bloomberg's Shaquille Omari reports from New York.

items.title: Dollar Tree (DLTR) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Changes
items.summary: Dollar Tree is back in focus as analysts reset their price targets across a wide band, from about US$121 to US$165. These moves reflect differing views on how quickly recent trends in traffic, pricing, and margin management might translate into steadier earnings and support those higher targets. items.summary: Key TakeawaysWalmart stock is up 10% in the past month while the Nasdaq 100 fell 11%, as investors moved out of tech and into consumer names like Home Depot and Dollar Tree. Michael Burry calls Walmart one of the market’s “generals.
